description: SandroGT Spider4SPARQL processed dev questions for museum_visit. Gold answers are populated from the RDF graph.

questions.nl_question: How many visitors below age 30 are there?

questions.gold_sparql: select ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?T1_name . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/level_of_membership> ?T1_level_of_membership . FILTER(?T1_level_of_membership > 4) . } ORDER BY DESC (?T1_level_of_membership)
questions.nl_question: Find the names of the visitors whose membership level is higher than 4, and order the results by the level from high to low.
What is the average age of the visitors whose membership level is not higher than 4?

questions.gold_sparql: select ?T1_name ?T1_level_of_membership WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?T1_name . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/level_of_membership> ?T1_level_of_membership . FILTER(?T1_level_of_membership > 4) . } ORDER BY DESC (?T1_age)
questions.nl_question: Find the name and membership level of the visitors whose membership level is higher than 4, and sort by their age from old to young.

questions.gold_sparql: select ?t1_museum_id ?t1_name where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/museum_id> ?t1_museum_id . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/num_of_staff> ?t1_num_of_staff . } order by desc (?t1_num_of_staff) limit 1
questions.nl_question: Find the id and name of the museum that has the most staff members?
Find the average number of staff working for the museums that were open before 2009.
What are the opening year and staff number of the museum named Plaza Museum?

questions.gold_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?T1_name . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/num_of_staff> ?T1_num_of_staff . FILTER(?T1_num_of_staff > ?aggregation_T22_num_of_staff_182) . {SELECT (min( ?T22_num_of_staff) as ?aggregation_T22_num_of_staff_182 ) WHERE { ?T22 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?T22 <http://valuenet/ontop/num_of_staff> ?T22_num_of_staff . ?T22 <http://valuenet/ontop/open_year> ?T22_open_year . FILTER(?T22_open_year > '2010') . } } }
questions.nl_question: find the names of museums which have more staff than the minimum staff number of all museums opened after 2010.

questions.gold_sparql: select ?t1_id ?t1_name ?t1_age where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-visitor> ?t1 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/age> ?t1_age . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . } group by ?t1_id ?t1_name ?t1_age having(count( *) > 1)
questions.nl_question: find the id, name and age for visitors who visited some museums more than once.

questions.gold_sparql: SELECT ?T1_name WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?T1_name . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/num_of_staff> ?T1_num_of_staff . FILTER(?T1_num_of_staff > ?aggregation_T22_num_of_staff_182) . {SELECT (min( ?T22_num_of_staff) as ?aggregation_T22_num_of_staff_182 ) WHERE { ?T22 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?T22 <http://valuenet/ontop/num_of_staff> ?T22_num_of_staff . ?T22 <http://valuenet/ontop/open_year> ?T22_open_year . FILTER(?T22_open_year > '2010') . } } }
questions.nl_question: What are the id, name and membership level of visitors who have spent the largest amount of money in total in all museum tickets?

questions.gold_sparql: SELECT ?T1_museum_id (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) ?T2_name WHERE { ?T1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?T2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-museum> ?T2 . ?T1 <http://valuenet/ontop/museum_id> ?T1_museum_id . ?T2 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?T2_name . } GROUP BY ?T1_museum_id ?T2_name ORDER BY DESC (?aggregation_all) LIMIT 1
questions.nl_question: What are the id and name of the museum visited most times?

questions.gold_sparql: select ?t1_name where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/museum_id> ?t1_museum_id . Filter not exists {{select ?t22_museum_id where { ?t22 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?t22 <http://valuenet/ontop/museum_id> ?t22_museum_id . } } FILTER (?t1_museum_id in (?t22_museum_id))} }
questions.nl_question: What is the name of the museum that had no visitor yet?

questions.gold_sparql: select ?t1_name ?t1_age where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-visitor> ?t1 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/age> ?t1_age . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/num_of_ticket> ?t2_num_of_ticket . } order by desc (?t2_num_of_ticket) limit 1
questions.nl_question: Find the name and age of the visitor who bought the most tickets at once.
What are the average and maximum number of tickets bought in all visits?

questions.gold_sparql: select (sum( ?t1_total_spent) as ?aggregation_t1_total_spent_166 ) where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-visitor> ?t2 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/total_spent> ?t1_total_spent . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/level_of_membership> ?t2_level_of_membership . FILTER(?t2_level_of_membership = 1) . }
questions.nl_question: What is the total ticket expense of the visitors whose membership level is 1?

questions.gold_sparql: select distinct ?t1_name where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?t2 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-visitor> ?t1 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/open_year> ?t3_open_year . ?t3 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?t2 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-museum> ?t3 . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t1_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . ?t3 <http://valuenet/ontop/open_year> ?t3_open_year . FILTER(?t3_open_year < '2009') . FILTER (?t1_name in (?t4_name)) . ?t4 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?t5 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?t5 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-visitor> ?t4 . ?t4 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t4_name . ?t4 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t4_id . ?t6 <http://valuenet/ontop/open_year> ?t6_open_year . ?t6 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?t5 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-museum> ?t6 . ?t4 <http://valuenet/ontop/name> ?t4_name . ?t4 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t4_id . ?t6 <http://valuenet/ontop/open_year> ?t6_open_year . FILTER(?t6_open_year > '2011') . }
questions.nl_question: What is the name of the visitor who visited both a museum opened before 2009 and a museum opened after 2011?

questions.gold_sparql: select (count( *) as ?aggregation_all) where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/id> ?t1_id . Filter not exists {{select ?t22_visitor_id where { ?t22 a <http://valuenet/ontop/visit> . ?t23 a <http://valuenet/ontop/museum> . ?t22 <http://valuenet/ontop/ref-museum> ?t23 . ?t22 <http://valuenet/ontop/visitor_id> ?t22_visitor_id . ?t23 <http://valuenet/ontop/open_year> ?t23_open_year . FILTER(?t23_open_year > '2010') . } } FILTER (?t1_id in (?t22_visitor_id))} }

How many museums were opened after 2013 or before 2008?
